deferred.topic: A proof certificate is a proof of `unsat` that a solver emits and an independent checker replays. cvc5 emits Alethe proofs, and Carcara checks them.
deferred.why: The roadmap defers proof-certificate infrastructure until a concrete proof obligation or implementation demands it.
deferred.trigger: Surfaces in Today when the solver-bug erosion fires: on the inputs of one public issue an older Z3 release answered `unsat` on satisfiable inputs {{run:RUN-z3-11179}}. It surfaces again when your final report logs a doubt about a flaw the checkers share. The card then shows a cvc5 Alethe proof that contains a `hole` step {{run:RUN-cvc5-alethe}}. A certificate with a gap is partial, so "uncertified" stays on solver-only stamps until a certificate replays.
